title: Bobby Kolli Promises 'Bigger and Grander' Mega 158 as Chiranjeevi Action Epic Takes Shape
excerpt: Behind-the-scenes footage from the Pollachi schedule and a Variety India interview reveal the scale and ambition behind the Chiranjeevi-Bobby Kolli reunion, with a title reveal expected on the Megastar's 71st birthday.
body:
• Director Bobby Kolli told Variety India that Mega 158 will be "much bigger and grander" than their previous collaboration Waltair Veerayya, promising a fresh take on Chiranjeevi's screen persona
  • The production has completed its first schedule in Pollachi and moved to a massive Hyderabad shoot, with BTS footage showing large-scale action sequences choreographed by Ram-Lakshman Masters
  • The film's official title remains under wraps, with industry reports indicating a reveal timed for Chiranjeevi's 71st birthday on August 22

Mega 158, the highly anticipated Telugu action entertainer reuniting Megastar Chiranjeevi with director Bobby Kolli, is progressing at rapid pace across two major shooting schedules—and the filmmaker is making no secret of his ambitions for the project.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=bNzXrRCZ_VY

In an exclusive interview with Variety India, Bobby Kolli laid out what distinguishes this film from his earlier work. "This film will be much bigger and grander than my previous projects, including Waltair Veerayya," he said. "While it won't be a vintage Chiranjeevi film, we've kept all the commercial elements. It'll be a treat for fans."

From Pollachi to Hyderabad

The production, bankrolled by Venkat K Narayana under KVN Productions in what marks the banner's debut Telugu venture, wrapped its first major schedule in Pollachi in mid-June before relocating to Hyderabad for a second phase of shooting. KVN Productions announced the transition on X, writing that the film was "progressing at a blazing pace, where Megastar is turning every shot into a spectacle."

https://x.com/TV9Telugu/status/2083424280025731156

A behind-the-scenes video released to mark the Pollachi wrap gave audiences a first look at the production's scale. The footage captured high-voltage action sequences choreographed by veteran stunt duo Ram-Lakshman Masters, who have a long working history with Chiranjeevi. The actor appeared in what reports describe as a "stylish yet intense" new look, flanked by co-stars Anaswara Rajan and Nivetha Pethuraj.

"You just lived it."

— Bobby Kolli to Chiranjeevi on set, captured in the BTS video

The clip also revealed Bobby Kolli's directing style in action—visibly moved by Chiranjeevi's performance during an action sequence, the filmmaker's reaction has gone viral among fan circles.

A Stacked Production Team

Mega 158 has assembled a formidable technical crew. S Thaman, who was officially announced as the music composer during the film's pooja ceremony on May 21, will handle both songs and background score. Vijay Karthik Kannan, the cinematographer behind Rajinikanth's Jailer, is behind the camera, while Avinash Kolla serves as production designer and Antony L Ruben as editor.

The screenplay is penned by Kona Venkat and K Chakravarthy Reddy, with additional writing from Hari Mohana Krishna and Vineeth Potluri. Dialogue duties fall to Bhanu-Nandu. The cast extends beyond the leads to include Priyamani and Rachita Ram in key roles, giving the project a multi-lingual ensemble.

Bobby Kolli, whose track record includes blockbusters with Jr NTR (Jai Lava Kusa), Nandamuri Balakrishna (Daaku Maharaj), and Chiranjeevi himself (Waltair Veerayya), told Variety India that his casting process is story-first. "I never think of stars before writing the script," he said. "Once I complete it, I imagine which actor will suit the character."

The Title Mystery

The film's official title remains one of Telugu cinema's most closely guarded secrets. During the "Spirit of Mega 158" video released at the shoot's commencement, Chiranjeevi and Bobby Kolli shared a playful exchange in which the director tried to stop the star from revealing the title. Chiranjeevi, in characteristic form, quipped that Bobby "cannot stop him" and that he would "leak the title at the right time."

Industry sources expect that moment to arrive on August 22, Chiranjeevi's 71st birthday—a date that has historically served as a launchpad for the Megastar's project announcements. The Mega 158 project itself was first announced on his 70th birthday last year with a concept poster featuring a blood-stained axe and the tagline "The blade that set the bloody benchmark."

What's Next

With the Hyderabad schedule underway and major action sequences being filmed, the production appears on track for what reports suggest could be a Sankranti 2027 release window—a festive slot that has delivered back-to-back hits for Chiranjeevi with Waltair Veerayya (2023) and Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu (2026). All eyes now turn to August 22 for what could be the film's formal title reveal and first glimpse.
nri_angle: Chiranjeevi remains one of the most bankable names for Telugu-language cinema in overseas markets, making Mega 158 a key title for diaspora audiences
